title: fix: log for own browser env var issues
body: Add logs in case user selected on browser but either forgot to add the right env vars (CHROME_PATH, CHROME_USER_DATA) or set them to incorrect paths
author: matthew1809

comments.body:
Hi, chrome_exe and chrome_use_data can actually be set to None. Currently, when the user doesn't specify them, they default to an empty string, which causes an error. You should change it to:

1. If chrome_exe is an empty string (''), set it to None. Otherwise, check if the chrome_exe path exists, and only then raise an error if it doesn't.

2. If chrome_use_data is an empty string (''), set it to None. There's no need to check if the chrome_use_data path exists because Playwright will automatically create it if it doesn't.

Thanks!

satisfaction_conditions: Handle empty environment variable values appropriately
Prevent unnecessary errors for default configurations
